reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: It doesn’t access any of your Spotify playlists. You must build your own playlist and download music to build your playlist. Then it doesn’t randomize your playlist so you wake up to the same first song every morning. You have no control over the volume so if you want a quiet alarm to slowly wake forget that. It’ll start quiet and then immediately get loud and blaring. It’d be nice if you could control the snooze time length. Also I think you can’t just set an alarm and let it run for eternity. You have to open the App every evening of your life if you want to wake up in time. So much potential with this app but overall not convenient.

reviews.title: Isn’t reliable
reviews.text: I’ve had this alarm for a couple weeks now and multiple times it has not gone off. For some reason, the music just doesn’t play. It looks like the alarm has gone off, but there was never any sound. I have deleted and reinstalled it and changed songs and still I never know if it’s going to work or not. So I have to set my regular iPhone alarm as a backup. What’s the point? I can’t believe I paid for this thing. Do NOT download this app.

Just downloaded it and I’m already deleting it, I do not recommend this app!
